tokens.npc_dota_hero_terrorblade_bio:
Terrorblade is the demon marauder--an outlaw hellion whom even other demons fear. A cosmic iconoclast, he stole from the Demon Lords, ignored the codified rites that should have bound his behavior, and broke every law of the seven Infernal Regions. For his crimes, he was taught this lesson: even Hell has a hell. A short, brutal trial ensued, with many dead on all sides, and he was finally incarcerated in Foulfell, a hidden dimension where demonkind imprison their own.

But Foulfell is no normal prison. In this dark mirror of reality, demons are sentenced to gaze eternally into the twisted reflection of their own souls. But instead of suffering, Terrorblade made himself master of his own reflected worst self--a raging, thieving demon of unimaginable power. With his inner beast under sway, he destroyed the fractal prison walls and burst free to turn his terror loose upon all creation.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_terrorblade_hype: With Terrorblade, nothing is as it seems. Conjuring powerful illusions to confuse enemies and break their defenses, the demon marauder can exchange health with foes and friends to stave off death or weaken his enemies.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_terrorblade_npedesc1: Transforms into a powerful ranged demon

With his inner beast under sway, he destroyed the fractal prison walls and burst free to turn his terror loose upon all creation.

qualifications.raw: All of Terrorblade's illusions that are within the radius will metamorph as well.
Metamorphosis Aura: Terrorblade's nearby illusions will match his current form.

* {{Symbol|a|Transform}}
** The [[transformation]] does not persist the following conditions:
*** Upon {{M|death}}.
*** Upon {{A|Terrorblade|Demon Zeal}} cast.
** {{Symbol|Aura}}
*** Applies a {{M|stun}} to the following units within the [[aura]] radius while transforming, and cannot be interrupted.
**** Terrorblade
**** Controllable {{M|illusions}} of Terrorblade's.
*** Grants the following bonuses within the [[aura]] radius:
**** Flat {{M|base attack damage}}.
**** {{Symbol|bonus atk}}
***** Grants attack range bonus corresponding to the caster's attack range-type.
***** Turns Terrorblade and all illusions within the radius into a {{M|ranged}} unit with {{calc|v1+{{Show|H|Terrorblade|atkrange}}|v1={{#var:Metamorphosis value4}}}} {{M|attack range}} for the entire duration.
****** Does not affect attack range manipulating sources.
****** {{M|Items}} that use different values for the wielder's [[attack range]]-type now considers the caster as a ranged unit.
**** {{Symbol|Attack Damage}} {{Symbol|Projectile|Travel}}
***** Has a 900-attack {{M|projectile speed}}.
** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|terrorblade_metamorphosis}}
*** Recasting the ability refreshes its buff duration.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|a|Transform}}
** The [[transformation]] does not persist the following conditions:
*** Upon {{M|death}}.
*** Upon {{A|Terrorblade|Demon Zeal}} cast.
** {{Symbol|Aura}}
*** Applies a {{M|stun}} to the following units within the [[aura]] radius while transforming, and cannot be interrupted.
**** Terrorblade
**** Controllable {{M|illusions}} of Terrorblade's.
*** Grants the following bonuses within the [[aura]] radius:
**** Flat {{M|base attack damage}}.
**** {{Symbol|bonus atk}}
***** Grants attack range bonus corresponding to the caster's attack range-type.
***** Turns Terrorblade and all illusions within the radius into a {{M|ranged}} unit with {{calc|v1+{{Show|H|Terrorblade|atkrange}}|v1={{#var:Metamorphosis value4}}}} {{M|attack range}} for the entire duration.
****** Does not affect attack range manipulating sources.
****** {{M|Items}} that use different values for the wielder's [[attack range]]-type now considers the caster as a ranged unit.
**** {{Symbol|Attack Damage}} {{Symbol|Projectile|Travel}}
***** Has a 900-attack {{M|projectile speed}}.
** {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|terrorblade_metamorphosis}}
*** Recasting the ability refreshes its buff duration.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* Acquiring {{M|Aghanim's Scepter}} unlocks this ability in the {{Spellslot|5|6}}.

* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
** The {{A|Terrorblade|Metamorphosis}} transformation does not persist the following conditions:
*** Upon {{M|death}}.
** Recasting this ability refreshes the {{Code|terrorblade_metamorphosis}} buff duration.

* {{Symbol|Projectile|Ripple}}
** Applies its ability effects with a [[Wikipedia:Annulus (mathematics)|ring]] centered around Terrorblade upon cast.
*** However, the ability effects do not move with Terrorblade.
** Expand outward in {{#var:Terror Wave basic1}}-speed with a total {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Terror Wave value1}}/{{#var:Terror Wave basic1}} round2}}-second expand time toward the max effect radius.
** The ability effects are applied as follows:
*** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
***# {{#var:Terror Wave value2}} seconds after casting, the ability effects expands outward in a thin ring.
***# {{Symbol|a|Transform}}
***#* While in Hero Form:
***#** Grants Terrorblade a {{#var:Terror Wave type1 value1}}-second {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|terrorblade_[[Terrorblade#Metamorphosis|metamorphosis]]}} buff of its corresponding level.
***#* While in {{A|Terrorblade|Metamorphosis|text=Demon Form}}:
***#** Considers as reapplying the {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|terrorblade_metamorphosis}} buff of its corresponding level. Hence, it extends the Demon Form duration for the same amount.

* {{Symbol|Teleport}} {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}} {{to}} {{hi|Terrorblade}}
** [[Teleport]] sources heading toward Terrorblade may avoid the Terror Wave ring.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_terrorblade
data.bio_loc:
Terrorblade is the demon marauder--an outlaw hellion whom even other demons fear. A cosmic iconoclast, he stole from the Demon Lords, ignored the codified rites that should have bound his behavior, and broke every law of the seven Infernal Regions. For his crimes, he was taught this lesson: even Hell has a hell. A short, brutal trial ensued, with many dead on all sides, and he was finally incarcerated in Foulfell, a hidden dimension where demonkind imprison their own.

But Foulfell is no normal prison. In this dark mirror of reality, demons are sentenced to gaze eternally into the twisted reflection of their own souls. But instead of suffering, Terrorblade made himself master of his own reflected worst self--a raging, thieving demon of unimaginable power. With his inner beast under sway, he destroyed the fractal prison walls and burst free to turn his terror loose upon all creation.
data.hype_loc: With Terrorblade, nothing is as it seems. Conjuring powerful illusions to confuse enemies and break their defenses, the demon marauder can exchange health with foes and friends to stave off death or weaken his enemies.
data.npe_desc_loc: Transforms into a powerful ranged demon

abilities.name: terrorblade_reflection
abilities.desc_loc: Terrorblade brings forth an invulnerable dark reflection of all enemy heroes in a target area. Affected enemy heroes have movement and attack speeds slowed and attacked by their reflection.
abilities.lore_loc: In the fractal prison of Foulfell, Terrorblade learned the truth of this old tale: you are your own worst enemy.  Now it is a lesson he teaches others.
notes_loc: Reflections are untargetable, invulnerable illusions, that will be destroyed if the slow debuff is removed.
Reflections can only attack their source.

abilities.name: terrorblade_conjure_image
abilities.desc_loc: Creates an illusion of Terrorblade that deals damage.
abilities.lore_loc: There's only one thing more dangerous than facing Terrorblade.  Facing MORE Terrorblades!
notes_loc: Illusions created by Conjure Image are visually different for enemies.
facets_loc: Conjure Image illusions always spawn at full health and cost health instead of mana.

abilities.name: terrorblade_metamorphosis
abilities.desc_loc: Terrorblade transforms into a powerful demon with a ranged attack. Any of Terrorblade's illusions that are within %metamorph_aura_tooltip% range will also be transformed by Metamorphosis.
abilities.lore_loc: Temper, temper. The rage rises up and takes control.  Meet Terrorblade's own worst self.
notes_loc: Cooldowns of items that are different for ranged and melee units will be based on which form Terrorblade was in when the item was used.

abilities.name: terrorblade_demon_zeal
abilities.desc_loc: Costs part of Terrorblade's current HP to cast, providing Terrorblade and nearby illusions bonus movement, HP Regen and attack speed. Does not affect Reflection illusions. Can't be cast while in Metamorphosis and Metamorphosis will remove Demon Zeal.
abilities.lore_loc: Fear is fueled by confusion when Terrorblade's enemies see that the first cut he makes is one to embolden himself.

abilities.name: terrorblade_terror_wave
abilities.desc_loc: Causes a wave to travel outwards in all directions forcing enemy heroes to become Feared upon impact and dealing damage, and grants Terrorblade Metamorphosis for a short time.
abilities.lore_loc: A shockwave of power strong enough to break the walls of Foulfell itself.

abilities.name: terrorblade_sunder
abilities.desc_loc: Severs the life from both Terrorblade and a target hero, exchanging a percentage of both units' current health. Some health points must remain.
abilities.lore_loc: You didn't need that life, did you?  The demon marauder steals that which you hold most dear.
notes_loc: Debuff Immune enemies don't get their HP modified.
facets_loc: There is no minimum health threshold for Sundered enemies.

abilities.desc_loc: Nearby Illusions created by Terrorblade have bonus attack damage.
